name: Inpainting SDS Loss
definition: A loss function using a pre-trained 2D diffusion inpainting model to provide generative priors, conditioning on text prompt and scene information to ensure harmonized composition.
summary: Inpainting SDS Loss uses a diffusion inpainting model conditioned on a binary mask to generate 3D content that integrates with existing scene geometry, solving the incomplete object generation issues of vanilla SDS.
